facts.fact: Minister Meriem Benmouloud says the national portal Dzair Digital Services, officially launched by the President, currently offers 21 digital services, to rise to 62 by end-2027 and 350 by 2028.

Minister Meriem Benmouloud says the portal brings together in one space the digital services of the different government sectors, with access through a digital identity linked to personal and biometric data, activated by appointment after registration.
